stemMarkdown: Two runners start at the same time from the same point on a circular track of length 600 m and run in opposite directions at 9 m/s and 14 m/s. After how many seconds will they first meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Running in opposite directions, relative speed $= 9 + 14 = 23$ m/s. They first meet after covering the full circumference between them: time $= \dfrac{600}{23} = 26.09$ s.
